headline: A 2001 order by President Bush set the order of officials who would lead the Department of Veterans Affairs if top leaders could not serve.
what_it_does: This executive order lists which Department of Veterans Affairs officials would step in to act as Secretary if the Secretary and other top leaders died, resigned, or could not do the job. It is meant to keep the department running without a gap in leadership. No summary was provided, so the exact list of positions and any other details are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Veterans Affairs
who_it_affects.how: It sets the order in which they would take over the Secretary's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 18, 2001; the effective date is not stated in the available information.
